blocks.text: Take control of your landscape irrigation with the Orbit B-hyve Smart Indoor/Outdoor Sprinkler Controller. Designed to simplify lawn and garden watering, this smart controller provides automated irrigation management for up to twelve independent watering zones. It helps homeowners maintain healthy lawns, gardens, and landscaped areas while improving overall water efficiency. The controller allows users to create customized watering schedules that match the specific needs of different zones around the property. Lawns, flower beds, vegetable gardens, and drip irrigation systems can all receive tailored watering programs to ensure optimal hydration without overwatering. This flexible zone-based system supports a wide range of landscape layouts and irrigation setups. Smart connectivity enables convenient control through a mobile app, allowing users to monitor and adjust watering schedules remotely. From anywhere with an internet connection, homeowners can start or stop watering cycles, modify irrigation plans, and fine-tune zone settings directly from their smartphone or tablet. This remote access provides greater flexibility and control over landscape irrigation. The system also uses weather-based intelligence to help optimize watering schedules. By adjusting irrigation timing based on weather conditions and seasonal changes, the controller helps reduce unnecessary watering and supports more efficient water management. For gardeners and homeowners who demand dependable outdoor care, Orbit brings industry-leading irrigation and watering solutions that simplify watering without compromising performance. With a focus on technology, durability, and real-world usability, our products make efficient water management effortless. Driven by innovation and shaped by decades of leadership in irrigation, Orbit helps landscapes flourish while giving users confidence in every watering decision.

items.label: Advanced Multi Zone Coverage
items.value: Built as a multi-zone sprinkler controller that supports multi zone irrigation, helping coordinate lawn sprinklers and drip systems with precision across landscapes
